Maria Chen: Hey team — external auditor asked for proof of RBAC change history + KMS decrypt/encrypt events for the last 90 days for the Dedicated cluster. They specifically want a control mapping to SOC 2 / ISO controls (RBAC, key management, audit logging). Can someone pull sample logs and a short mapping snippet? @kevin @irene

Kevin Patel: On it. Quick Q: full CloudTrail export or just filtered extracts for Decrypt/Encrypt/DisableKey operations? Also which key alias should we use for the KMS evidence? Dedicated uses alias/redwood/dedicated-1, right?

Irene Gomez: We should provide three things: (1) RBAC audit trail (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding changes) with actor + config diff, (2) KMS events (Decrypt, Encrypt, Revoke/Disable, CreateAlias) and any policy changes, (3) chain-of-custody + hash of the packaged evidence. I'll start with the queries.

Kevin Patel: Here's a quick CloudTrail/Athena query I use to pull KMS Decrypts (change date range as needed):

```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, resources
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventSource='kms.amazonaws.com' AND eventName='Decrypt'
AND eventTime >= date_add('day', -90, current_date)
ORDER BY eventTime DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

For RBAC diffs, we pull audit events from the cluster audit log + etcd snapshots:

```bash
kubectl get events -n kube-system --field-selector involvedObject.kind=RoleBinding -o json | jq '.items[] | {ts: .metadata.creationTimestamp, user: .user, verb: .verb, name: .metadata.name}'
```

Maria Chen: Perfect. Auditor also asked for a signed artifact and sha256 hash of the evidence package. We need to tar.gz the exports, compute sha256, then sign with our asymmetric audit key in KMS. @sam can you confirm the KMS signing workflow and which key alias to use?

Sam Villar: Yes — we use an asymmetric key for signing: alias/redwood/audit-signing. Workflow: create artifact, compute sha256sum, call kms:Sign with SigningAlgorithm=RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256, store signature alongside artifact, and include a manifest.json that lists files, hashes, and redaction notes. I'll draft a small runbook and include the CLI snippet.

Irene Gomez: Important: redact any PII before packaging. Use jq/sed to remove client IPs and session tokens from the logs. Example redaction snippet:

```bash
jq 'del(.requestParameters.clientIpAddress, .userIdentity.sessionContext)' raw_cloudtrail.json > redacted.json
```

auditor-bot: Thanks — please also include the control mapping table (control id -> evidence filename -> collection method) and indicate retention windows. We'll validate and follow up with any spot checks.

Kevin Patel: I'll assemble a CSV mapping like that and drop it in /shared/compliance/soc2/q1-2026/rbac-kms-mapping.csv. Also exporting a small sample (first 500 lines) for auditor review.

Maria Chen: Can we target EOD tomorrow to hand over the signed package? :calendar:

Sam Villar: Yes — I'll post the runbook, signature sample, and HSM key alias by 12:00 PST tomorrow. Tagging @Irene for redaction review.

Irene Gomez: ACK. Also flagging a vuln triage note — while sampling logs I found an alert for a high-severity container escape (CVE-2024-xxxx) on node infra-prod-3. I filed incident INC-4523 and applied the node taint + image rollback as mitigation. Will attach the incident summary and timeline to the evidence bundle.

Kevin Patel: Good call — auditors want linkage to incidents. I'll add INC-4523 and mitigation notes to the manifest and control mapping. Link to incident: https://redwood-internal/infra/incidents/INC-4523

Maria Chen: Great. Include the incident ID, ticket link, and post-mortem stub. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
